say:1:1621787001:1.text: Girod, what's your secret to improving so fast?
say:1:1621787001:1.source_cn: 吉罗德，你是怎么做到突然变得这么优秀的？

say:2:1621787002:1.text: You're the top scorer in the illusion exam! The professor says you're good enough to graduate!
say:2:1621787002:1.source_cn: 你是幻术魔法考试的第一名，第一名！教授说，你的魔法水平...

say:4:1621787003:1.text: You must be a prodigy! Why did you hold back your talent until now?
say:4:1621787003:1.source_cn: 你真行，之前可一点都没看出来你魔法天赋这么强，是个被埋...

say:5:1621787004:1.text: If you weren't still tone-deaf, I might not even recognize you!
say:5:1621787004:1.source_cn: 要不是你还是五音不全，我真的要认不出来你了，哈哈！

say:6:1621787005:1.text: Really? Didn't Girod just join the vocal club?
say:6:1621787005:1.source_cn: 吉罗德五音不全？他前几天不还参加了声乐社团吗？

say:7:1621787006:1.text: He seems to have damaged his vocal cords, and he hasn't been able to sing since. I'm afraid his voice now is...
say:7:1621787006:1.source_cn: 好像是说之前不小心伤到了嗓子，之后都不太能唱歌了。我也...

say:8:1621787007:1.text: Shh... Girod might still be touchy about his voice. But then again, no one's perfect. Being tone-deaf is just a minor flaw...
say:8:1621787007:1.source_cn: 嘘……小声点，多伤人啊。不过人哪能没有什么缺点呢，只是...

narration:9:1621787008:1.text: The remarks about Girod put you at ease. Thankfully, the mirror monster remains committed to his role as the perfect Girod.
narration:9:1621787008:1.male: The remarks about Girod put you at ease. Thankfully, the mirror monster remains committed to his role as the perfect Girod.
narration:9:1621787008:1.female: The remarks about Girod put you at ease. Thankfully, the mirror monster remains committed to his role as the perfect Girod.

narration:10:1621787009:1.text: As you turn to leave, a flicker of doubt surfaces in your mind...
narration:10:1621787009:1.male: As you turn to leave, a flicker of doubt surfaces in your mind...
narration:10:1621787009:1.female: As you turn to leave, a flicker of doubt surfaces in your mind...

narration:11:1621787010:1.text: ... Why is Girod still tone-deaf? Is the mirror monster affected by the real Girod, or is there some other reason?

narration:12:1621787011:1.text: The answer is anyone's guess. All you can do is quietly watch how things unfold after your choice…
narration:12:1621787011:1.male: The answer is anyone's guess. All you can do is quietly watch how things unfold after your choice…
narration:12:1621787011:1.female: The answer is anyone's guess. All you can do is quietly watch how things unfold after your choice…
